text: Hitachi, Ltd.'s annual securities report for the fiscal year ended 31 March 2026 (157th business term) lists Hitachi Systems, Ltd. among its principal consolidated subsidiaries, with Hitachi holding 100.0% of the voting rights.
short: Hitachi Systems, Ltd. is a wholly owned subsidiary of Hitachi, Ltd.

source.name: Hitachi, Ltd.: Annual Securities Report for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026, Note 27 'Principal Subsidiaries'
